crossRefs.note: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard, and came to Mitylene.

people.name: Assos
people.line: A seaport in Mysia, visited by Paul.

people.name: Mitylene
people.line: A city on the island of Lesbos visited by Paul

translations.web: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard, and came to Mitylene.
translations.bsb: And when he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
translations.kjv: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
translations.asv: And when he met us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
